entries.finding: Qualified local training checkpoint includes NumPy optimizer/RNG objects. weights_only=True inspection failed; hash-verified trusted local weights_only=False load is explicit.
Official CCD/MAE checkpoint metadata required a narrow numeric/codecs/argparse allowlist for weights_only=True; no unrestricted external checkpoint load was used.
Uppercase segmentation namespace did not match official lowercase module.segmentation keys. Strict loader stopped; corrected exact namespace, all tensors loaded strictly.
CUDA linear1d backward rejected deterministic mode. Curve interpolation moved to CPU with differentiable transfer; deterministic mode remains enabled. Failed smoke receipts retained.
Sample ID collisions between TRAIN and TEST require phase-specific joins and RGB SHA256. Separate gate fitting before TEST loading is tested.
Identically repeated auxiliary queries provide no diversity. Added GT-independent training reference jitter and isolation test; prior-only FP32 cache reused after bitwise replay checks.
One prepare invocation began before source-copy completion and exited with module-not-found. Retried only after copy completion; no scientific run or output existed for the failed invocation.
Package metadata included a missing Name; explicit missing-name label preserves the entry while sorting the inventory.

Official checkpoint downloaded and hashed, but official inspected source repository lacks executable model implementation. Original SIGA not executed; adapted guidance uses actual qualified CCD glyph teacher.

Inherited integer-edge metric IoU empties normalized reference boxes. A separate floating IoU now implements NMS; integer-edge original-pixel metric remains explicit. Source snapshot v3 preserves identical training code hashes.

Stopping the old supervisor interrupted its offline export after a partial cache, with no final completion record. The replacement supervisor resumed missing per-image exports with the same frozen model. First-attempt raw responses/logs are retained; final memory/time receipt covers the resumed process, not the full original attempt.

Official pinned mae/main_pretrain.py specifies RGB bicubic and Normalize(mean=std=0.5), distinct from the ImageNet-normalized later fine-tuning recipe. Initial cache archived, corrected GPU FP32 targets published for1130 TRAIN images before MAE branch initialization. Four completed methods unchanged; interrupted CCD epoch resumed at its complete epoch boundary with the same source hashes.

The first three live smokes were functionally correct but a CUDA tensor diagnostic found retained PARSeq model weights after reference cleanup. Explicitly transfer both models to CPU before release. Three final real routes preserve exact student boxes/crop hashes/text/confidence; post-release diagnostic finds no CUDA tensors, with32MiB runtime allocation. Initial successful functional outputs and diagnostic are archived.

The initial reporter required a historical corrective-MAE receipt and external supervisor state even for directly correct manual reruns. The maintained teacher audit now records its qualified preprocessing. Reporting accepts either explicit correct qualification path, rejects stale recipes or failed historical receipts, and still validates every completed warmup/branch epoch/checkpoint. Existing completed scientific outputs are unchanged; two regression tests cover fresh and historical contracts.
